entry.header: Control plane · every action is recorded

key.title: Use your security key
key.body: Insert or tap one of your registered keys. Phone passkeys aren’t accepted here.

failed.title: That key didn’t work
failed.body: Nothing changed. Try again, or use your other key.

entry.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.

enroll.title: Register two security keys
enroll.body: You need two keys: one to use, one as a backup. You can’t open the Control Plane until both are registered.

enrollSecond.title: Now your backup key
enrollSecond.body: Use a different physical key. Keep it somewhere safe.

entry.duplicate: That key is already registered. Use a different physical key.
entry.rejected: That key can’t be used here. Use a hardware security key, not a phone or a synced passkey.

enrollDone.title: Your keys are registered
enrollDone.body: You can now open the Control Plane. What you can see depends on the permissions an operator manager gave you.

reverify.title: Confirm it’s you again
reverify.body: Your security check has expired. Use your key to continue where you were.

recovery.title: Lost your keys?
recovery.body: There’s no self-service recovery. Another operator manager can revoke your old keys and let you register new ones. If you’re the last one, recovery is a reviewed procedure with SimpleFit’s maintainers.

enrollmentExpired.title: Your setup window has ended
enrollmentExpired.body: Your security keys weren’t registered in time. Ask an operator manager to set up your access again.

unsupported.title: This browser can’t use security keys
unsupported.body: Open SimpleFit in a current browser that supports hardware security keys.

serviceUnavailable.title: Security keys aren’t available right now

unavailable.title: We can’t find that page
unavailable.body: This page doesn’t exist, or it isn’t available to your account.

workspace.keyChecked: Key checked · {minutes, plural, one {# min} other {# min}} left
workspace.permissions: {count, plural, one {# permission} other {# permissions}} · each granted separately
workspace.exitFailed: We couldn’t end the key check. Try again.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.heading: Welcome to the Control Plane
welcome.body: This is where SimpleFit is run. You see only what you’ve been granted.

access.title: Your access
access.notYet: Overview, users, gyms, gym verification and system health aren’t part of the Control Plane yet.

welcome.note: A tour or checklist never adds access. Only an operator manager can, and that’s recorded.
welcome.failed: We couldn’t save that. Nothing changed. Try again.

steps.check: Check what the action does and to whom.
steps.result: The result, or an honest “we don’t know yet”, and an audit entry.

tour.failed: We couldn’t save that. Nothing changed. Try again.

finishing.title: Finishing…
finishing.body: Saving that you finished the tour.

finishFailed.title: We couldn’t finish the tour
finishFailed.body: Nothing was saved. Try again, or skip the tour.

confirm.label: Skip the tour
confirm.title: Skip the tour?
confirm.body: You won’t see it again. Everything it shows stays on this page.

welcome.title: What this is
welcome.body: The Control Plane runs SimpleFit. This card lists exactly what you can open.

sensitive.title: Sensitive actions
sensitive.body: Reason, key check, confirmation, then a result you can trust.

me.title: Your key check and leaving
me.body: Your key check and permissions are shown here. “Exit control plane” ends your key check.

done.title: You’re ready
done.body: You won’t see this again. Everything it showed stays in the menu.

overview.title: Overview

population.title: Population
population.asOf: As of {time} · a count, not a trend

accounts.label: Accounts
accounts.caption: registered · {notFinished, plural, one {# not finished} other {# not finished}}

gyms.label: Gyms
gyms.caption: completed · {drafts, plural, one {# draft} other {# drafts}}
gyms.period: {count, plural, one {# completed setup} other {# completed setup}} {range}

sponsor_organizations.label: Sponsor orgs
sponsor_organizations.caption: active · {suspended, plural, one {# suspended} other {# suspended}}

population.restrictedHint: Needs a permission you don’t have

reviews.title: Waiting for review

gymVerifications.label: Gym verifications
gymVerifications.unavailable: Not available yet: there’s no operator review for gyms.

reviews.moderation: Moderation isn’t available: there’s no reports domain yet.

health.title: System health
health.note: Unknown is never shown as healthy. Nothing here is an uptime figure.

degraded.title: Some background jobs failed in the last 24 hours.

overview.restricted: Other sections need permissions you don’t have.

forbidden.title: The overview needs permissions you don’t have
forbidden.body: An operator manager can grant them. Nothing here is hidden as zero.

search.label: Exact email or user ID
search.note: Search is exact by design: there’s no list of everyone. Each search is recorded with its reason.
search.idle: Enter an exact email or user ID, and a reason.

noMatch.title: No account matches
noMatch.body: Check the address or ID. Search doesn’t do partial matches.

search.rateLimited: Too many searches. Wait a while, then try again.

restricted.title: You don’t have access to this section
restricted.body: Your operator permissions don’t include it. An operator manager can grant it, with a reason that’s recorded.

detail.title: Account
detail.reasonTitle: Why are you opening this account?
detail.reasonBody: Every view is recorded with its reason.

notFound.title: No such account
notFound.body: Check the ID, or search again.

contexts.title: Contexts
contexts.never: Never shown here: passwords, codes, tokens, provider data, training sessions, coach notes, weight, health and messages.

security.title: Account and security
security.verification: A sign-in method means the person proved control of it. No identity or document check exists.

detail.recovery: There’s no account recovery to run here: sign-in is passwordless. Operators can’t change sign-in methods, verify anything or act as the person.

actions.smallScreen: High-risk actions need a larger screen and a security key. Reading works here.
actions.operatorTarget: This account is a platform operator: it’s managed in operator administration.

reveal.title: Reveal this email address?
reveal.body: Needs users.reveal_email and a fresh key check. Recorded with your reason.
reveal.failed: We couldn’t reveal it. Nothing was shown.

impacts.signed_out_everywhere: They’re signed out on every device now.
impacts.sign_in_refused: They can’t sign in with any method until the suspension is lifted.
impacts.memberships_unchanged: Gym and Sponsor memberships aren’t changed.
impacts.sessions_stay_revoked: Sessions ended by the suspension stay ended.

action.stepUp: Confirm with your security key. High-risk actions need a key check in the last few minutes.
action.success: Done. Recorded in the audit log.
action.conflict: Someone else changed this first. Nothing was changed. Reload to see the current state.
action.unknown: We don’t know if this went through. Don’t retry yet. Reload the account to check.
action.failed: That didn’t work. Nothing changed. Try again.
action.denied: You no longer have permission for this. Nothing changed.

protected.self: You can’t do this to your own account.
protected.operator: This account is a platform operator: use operator administration.
